cases.note: dive imports only klauspost/compress/zstd, whose non-test import closure (fse, huff0, internal/*, zstd/internal/xxhash) never includes s2; docker/cli's vendored compress has no s2 at all, and no other dive dependency imports s2. s2.NewDict also has no internal callers in compress v1.18.0.

The s2 package is compiled in (mholt/archives sz.go uses s2.NewReader/NewWriter), but nothing calls s2.NewDict: archives only uses reader/writer options, s2 itself never calls NewDict in non-test code, and bodgit/sevenzip uses only zstd/flate.

filippo.io/edwards25519 is used by go-sql-driver/mysql v1.9.2 (auth.go) and go.step.sm/crypto v0.74.0 (x25519), but they only use NewScalar/ScalarBaseMult/VarTimeDoubleScalarBaseMult/SetBytes etc.; no code calls Point.MultiScalarMult, and edwards25519 itself has no internal caller of it.

Xray does not import klauspost/compress; its only user in the module graph is utls (u_handshake_client.go imports compress/zstd), and xtls/reality, quic-go and grpc do not import it, so s2 is not even built; s2.NewDict has no internal callers in v1.17.4.

dive imports only docker/cli cli/config, cli/connhelper, cli/context/docker and cli/context/store; their transitive docker/cli import closure (config/*, connhelper/*, context, context/store) contains neither cli-plugins/manager nor cli/command/container, so no listed target or the advisory package is even compiled. The code gives a clear NOT_REACHABLE.

mapstructure v2 is used only by viper v1.20.0 (viper.go), and only via decode()/defaultDecoderConfig, which are called only from Unmarshal, UnmarshalKey, UnmarshalExact and decodeStructKeys; dive never calls any of these (it uses Get*/SetDefault/BindPFlag/AllSettings/ReadInConfig only). The missing symbol (StringToNetIPPrefixHookFunc) does not exist in v2.2.1 so it cannot be reached either.

No pgweb dependency imports logrus, and pgweb's own code never calls Writer/WriterLevel on a Logger or Entry (no such call anywhere, no interface with that method, no MethodByName/template use); writerScanner/writerFinalizer are only reached from Entry.WriterLevel. Linker PRESENT is most likely method retention, not a call; the code gives a clear NOT_REACHABLE.

Steps 1-9 exist (detect Run -> DetectSource -> File.Fragments -> extractorFragments -> Rar.Extract), but step 10 calls rardecode.FileSystem only if r.FS != nil; the Rar value comes from archives.Identify, which returns the zero Rar{} registered in init, and neither gitleaks nor archives ever sets FS. Target is also context only.

Step 7 splices two unrelated sync.Once uses: on this path Once.Do is called from internal/godebug.Setting.Value with godebug's own closure (lookup of the setting), so doSlow's f() cannot be grpctransport.otelGRPCStatsHandler$1 here. Remaining steps (otelgrpc.NewClientHandler -> otel.Handle -> ErrDelegator.Handle) exist but this path from crypto/fips140 init cannot run.

doMac calls doPBMAC1 only when macData.Mac.Algorithm is oidPBMAC1, but on this path Encode sets it to enc.macAlgorithm, and p12Action uses pkcs12.Modern (SHA-256) or LegacyRC2 (SHA-1); no encoder can carry PBMAC1. Also step 4->5 uses App.Run's default a.Action (a custom closure in root.go:134), not the p12 subcommand action.

createDatabase calls conn.Exec with only a SQL string and no arguments; pgx exec then uses the simple protocol, but execSimpleProtocol calls sanitizeForSimpleQuery only if len(arguments) > 0, so step 15 (and the sanitize target) never runs on this path. Step 4->5 is also a splice (App.Run default Action is the root closure, not ca initAction).

The path goes dsWorker.Start -> internet.ListenUnix, which always passes net.Port(0) to ListenXH; in ListenXH the port==0 branch takes the UNIX-socket listener, and the HTTP/3 goroutine (hub.go:410-411) is only in the else-if isH3 branch, so it cannot run via ListenUnix. (HTTP/3 is plausibly reachable via a TCP worker, but not on this path.)

Step 3 is impossible: base.Execute calls fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, ...) at execute.go:72, so w.Write inside Fprintf is (*os.File).Write, never utls.UConn.Write. The utls steps 5-12 exist but this path cannot reach them.

Steps 1-9 check out (api adu command -> dialAPIServer close closure -> ClientConn.Close -> tearDown -> http2Client.Close -> controlBuf.put), but at step 10 the item flowing through this path is the *goAway built at http2_client.go:1030, so it.isTransportResponseFrame() calls goAway's method, not cleanupStream's. The callee is valid elsewhere (closeStream), so this is a context splice; medium only because of how strictly per-path context is judged.
